Below is a practical, step‑by‑step guide you can follow to build a modern, production‑ready front‑end for your e‑commerce site. I’ll cover the whole pipeline – from choosing a framework to deploying the finished product – and sprinkle in code snippets, best‑practice tips, and useful links so you can jump straight into implementation. --- ## 1️⃣ Pick Your Tech Stack | Option | Why it’s good for e‑commerce | Typical tech | |--------|-----------------------------|--------------| | **React + Next.js** | Server‑side rendering (SSR) for SEO, static generation (SSG) for fast pages, rich ecosystem | React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Zustand/Vuex/Redux | | **Vue + Nuxt.js** | Similar SSR/SSG benefits, simpler learning curve if you’re new to React | Vue, Nuxt.js, Pinia, Vuetify/Tailwind | | **SvelteKit** | Compile‑time optimizations → smaller bundle size, great developer experience | SvelteKit, Svelte stores, Tailwind | | **Angular** | Opinionated, built‑in services & DI, great for large teams | Angular CLI, RxJS, Angular Material | > **Recommendation:** If you already have a Node.js backend, **Next.js** gives you the fastest path to production with zero‑config API routes, image optimisation, and incremental static regeneration (ISR). --- ## 2️⃣ Project Skeleton ```bash npx create-next-app@latest ecommerce-frontend --typescript cd ecommerce-frontend npm install tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer npx tailwindcss init -p ``` *Add Tailwind config (`tailwind.config.js`)* ```js module.exports = { content: [ "./pages/**/*.{ts,tsx}", "./components/**/*.{ts,tsx}" ], theme: { extend: {} }, plugins: [] } ``` *Add global styles (`styles/globals.css`)* ```css @tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities; ``` --- ## 3️⃣ Design System & UI Components ### 3.1 Create a Component Library ```bash mkdir components/ui touch components/ui/Button.tsx components/ui/Card.tsx ``` **Button component** ```tsx // components/ui/Button.tsx import { ButtonHTMLAttributes } from 'react'; export const Button = ({ children, variant = 'primary', ...props }: ButtonHTMLAttributes) => { const classes = `px-4 py-2 rounded ${ variant === 'primary' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700' : 'border border-gray-300 text-gray-800 hover:border-gray-400' }`; return ( ); }; ``` ### 3.2 Use a UI Kit (Optional) If you prefer pre‑built components: - **Shadcn/ui** – Tailwind‑based, composable, accessible. - **Chakra UI** – Themeable, accessible, works with React/Next. - **Headless UI** – Unstyled primitives for building custom UIs. --- ## 4️⃣ State Management | Option | When to use | Example | |--------|-------------|---------| | **Zustand** | Small to medium apps, minimal boilerplate | `create((set) => ({ cart: [], addToCart: (item) => set(state => ({ cart: [...state.cart, item] })) }))` | | **Redux Toolkit** | Large teams, complex logic, devtools | `configureStore({ reducer: rootReducer })` | | **React Context + useReducer** | Simple global state | `const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(reducer, initialState)` | > **Tip:** For e‑commerce, keep *cart*, *wishlist*, and *auth* in a global store; everything else can stay local to the page/component. --- ## 5️⃣ Routing & Page Structure | Feature | Implementation | |---------|----------------| | **Product Listing** | `/products/[category]/[page].tsx` | | **Product Detail** | `/product/[slug].tsx` | | **Cart** | `/cart` | | **Checkout** | `/checkout` | | **User Profile** | `/account` | | **Admin Dashboard** | `/admin/*` (protected route) | Use **dynamic routing** in Next.js for SEO‑friendly URLs: ```tsx // pages/product/[slug].tsx import { GetStaticPaths, GetStaticProps } from 'next'; import { fetchProductBySlug, fetchAllSlugs } from '../../lib/api'; export const getStaticPaths: GetStaticPaths = async () => { const slugs = await fetchAllSlugs(); // returns ['tshirt', 'jeans'] return { paths: slugs.map(slug => ({ params: { slug } })), fallback: 'blocking' // ISR }; }; export const getStaticProps: GetStaticProps = async ({ params }) => { const product = await fetchProductBySlug(params?.slug); return { props: { product }, revalidate: 60 }; // Rebuild every minute }; ``` --- ## 6️⃣ Data Fetching | Strategy | Where to use | Code | |----------|--------------|------| | **getStaticProps / getServerSideProps** | Product pages, category listings | `export const getStaticProps = async () => { /* fetch */ }` | | **React Query** | Cart updates, user profile | `useQuery(['cart'], fetchCart)` | | **SWR** | Lightweight caching | `const { data, error } = useSWR('/api/cart')` | > **Why SWR/React Query?** They automatically cache, dedupe requests, and provide optimistic updates—crucial for a smooth shopping experience. --- ## 7️⃣ Styling & Responsiveness - **Tailwind CSS** – Utility‑first, responsive breakpoints out of the box. - **CSS Modules** – Scoped styles for isolated components. - **Styled Components** – If you prefer CSS-in-JS. **Responsive grid example** ```tsx
